title: ECDSA global mutex serializes all sign/verify across all threads
description: Scenario: TLS server with N concurrent handshakes — N ECDSA DO_SIGN calls queue behind g_ecdsa_fd_lock. All use the single g_crypto2dev_fd. Maintenance consequence: throughput regression reports that require pool-based ECDSA to fix; the architectural limitation is hard to explain to users and requires a non-trivial pool change. The in-code comment calls out the bottleneck and the fix path (validate DO_SIGN on non-global pool fds) but leaves the limitation in place. This is a ship-now-fix-later decision that needs to be tracked explicitly.
